turns.query: Who was the top goal scorer in the 2024-2025 Premier League and how many did they score?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT tss_top_scorer_name, tss_top_scorer_goals FROM team_season_standings tss JOIN seasons s ON tss.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2024-2025' AND tss_rank = 1;

turns.query: In the 2024-2025 Premier League, which player scored the most league goals, and how many?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT tss_top_scorer_name, tss_top_scorer_goals FROM team_season_standings tss JOIN seasons s ON tss.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2024-2025' AND tss_rank = 1;
